description: Fetch accessibility issues from a completed scan with pagination support. Use cursor parameter to get subsequent pages of results. Requires the ids of a completed scan, which are returned by startAccessibilityScan. No tool here lists past scans, so if you do not have the ids, start a new scan rather than guessing.

scanId.description: The scan ID from a completed accessibility scan

scanRunId.description: The scan run ID from a completed accessibility scan

name: fetchAccessibilityIssues
